title: Shortest superpermutation on 6 symbols
statement: Find a string over 1..6 that contains every permutation of 1..6 as 6 consecutive characters, as short as possible. The shortest known, by Houston (2014), has length 872; a shorter one improves it.
submission: Text file: the string, digits 1..6 (whitespace ignored).
score: the length of the string (smaller is better)

best_known.source: L(6) <= 872: Houston (2014), in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026
